topic: Explicit Nambu conjugacy and the twelve-plane incidence configuration in Graffeo–Gubbiotti, Remark 7.7
title: Graffeo–Gubbiotti, Remark 7.7 (arXiv:2301.09129v2, pp. 35–37): Nambu conjugacy and the twelve-plane configuration

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: We prove the projective-conjugacy conjecture in Graffeo–Gubbiotti, Remark 7.7, arXiv:2301.09129v2, pp. 35–37, for quadratic Nambu Hamiltonians with a positive-definite first form and simple generalized spectrum. An explicit simultaneous-congruence reduction and Euler cubic identity give the conjugator. The six reducible net members split into the twelve planes v_i±v_j=0 through eight projective sign points, with six planes at every point and four points on every plane; the conjugator sends the points to the normal-form tetrahedra. The written proof extends conjugacy to regular complex symmetric pencils with three distinct projective determinant roots. For real positive-definite first form, repeated generalized eigenvalues give degree 2n+1 in the double case and degree 1 in the scalar case, complementing the cited generic law 2n^2+1.
summary: Explicit conjugacy, square composition factors, six reducible quadrics and all 48 point-plane incidences; simple complex pencils and the complete real positive-definite spectral multiplicity cases are included.

posing_source.locator: Remark 7.7, pp. 35–37; equations (7.15)–(7.23) and the concluding incidence question

formal_statement.scope: Existence of two invertible complex 4-by-4 matrices factoring the homogeneous Kahan lift through the standard cubic Cremona map, for real positive-definite A and B, rank(B-tA)>=2 for every real t, and h>0.

auxiliary_declarations.name: covariance
auxiliary_declarations.scope: Equality of the Nambu and Euler lifts under a specified real simultaneous congruence.

auxiliary_declarations.name: assembly
auxiliary_declarations.scope: Constructs the conjugator internally and proves the public factorization proposition from the preceding identities and positive-definite spectral reduction.

written_proof_scope: Theorem 1 proves explicit conjugacy for A positive definite, B real symmetric with simple generalized spectrum and nonzero real step. Corollaries 2–4 establish composition constants, base loci, eight reduced points, six reducible quadrics and the full twelve-plane incidence. Corollary 5 treats complex symmetric pencils with three distinct projective determinant roots. Corollary 6 gives all spectral-multiplicity degree laws for real positive-definite A; the generic degree law is the cited Graffeo–Gubbiotti theorem transported by conjugacy.
exact_algebra: verify.py checks 23 symbolic identity groups with 107 zero residuals, all 48 sign-point/plane incidences, all eight normal-form point images, and four double-spectrum iterate degrees.
